title: Kiwi
body:
"A brown fruit with a green inside! Some even say that Kiwi birds are made out of these things."

Description

The Kiwi is an item that can be found on bushes on Ferwater Island.

It may be sold to Jer Junkman for $180 per Kiwi. In its jam form it may be sold for $720

When put into a Composter, the fill level increases by ~1.19% per kiwi.

As of August 12, the Kiwi is the latest fruit to be added to Oaklands and was intended to be a 'mystery fruit' for players to find themselves. It took the community 6 minutes to find it.
